title: Micro-SaaS Launch System
audience: Independent builders moving a validated opportunity through MVP and launch.
shortDescription: Move from validated opportunity through MVP, launch, and initial revenue.
coreOutcome: Build and launch the smallest useful product around validated demand.
problem: An MVP can still become an open-ended build when launch, activation, and acquisition are deferred.
situation: The opportunity has evidence, but product scope and go-to-market work need to move together.
commonFailure: Treating launch as a date after development postpones the customer feedback required to shape the product.
methodology: Translate validation into scope, build the minimum useful loop, prepare acquisition and activation, launch, and learn.
capabilities: Measure activation and early commercial signals
whoItsFor: Bootstrapped builders with a sufficiently validated opportunity
whoItsNotFor: Ideas that have not yet earned a build decision
